# `browser-tab group`

- **Usage**: `browser-tab group [FLAGS] <action>`

Manage Chrome tab groups (create|add|remove|update|move)

## Arguments

### `<action>`

## Flags

### `--tabs <ids>`

Comma-separated tab handles (create/add/remove)

### `--group <id>`

Group handle (add/remove/update/move)

### `--browser <name>`

chrome|chromium|brave

### `--title <title>`

Group title (create/update)

### `--color <color>`

Group color (create/update)

### `--collapsed`

Collapse the group (update)

### `--target-window <id>`

Destination window (move)

### `--index <n>`

0-based destination position (move)
